author: Codex root
overall_phase: 1 problem and method formulation; current branch source demand/platform fit and pre-G0 functional gate
experimental_platform: Genesys2/CVA6 + four iDMA + RISC-V IOMMU + Linux; server is execution/build/analysis host only
scenario_preference: GPU/AI first, not exclusive; no requirement to emulate full commercial GPU inference

source_contract.object: complete OPT125m one-layer MLP six FP16 weight tensors, h=768
source_contract.payload: injective transfer-test bit patterns; no trained weights or inference output
source_contract.source_first_hop: mapped-file CPU copy to pinned relay; neither an observed NVMe DMA nor a second accelerator
source_contract.source_sync: complete tensor fill before its relay-to-CUDA copy; existing disk queue/CUDA synchronization retained as source semantics

platform_fit.accepted: finite source-derived operand-preparation transfer projection, actual DMA/translation execution in RTL diagnostic
platform_fit.physical_projection: DID10 fill proxy and DID11 operand-copy proxy; no GPU/SSD naming or stream-to-DID assertion

functional_acceptance.bus_boundary: raw AR/AW/B headers independently checked; R/W/TL totals use runtime observer counters, no independent per-beat replay
functional_acceptance.region_boundary: full source/relay/target 16MiB regions checked by runtime driver; independent checker validates source payload and final six tensors/holes

decision_reason: In this projection the source is already DMA-accessible DDR and resident_direct completes the same six-tensor useful object. The source first hop is CPU memcopy. Requiring the extra relay cannot establish mandatory shared-IOMMU device interference or an independent protection-method benefit. This closes only the optional-relay premise, not GPU/AI scenarios or the research field.
next_decisive_task: Define one source-supported AI transfer scenario with independently useful mandatory device work on both roles, without forcing optional relay traffic. Verify task identity, source/destination, immutable readiness, dependency, mapping, useful completion, legal ordinary policies and costs on the existing FPGA projection; then register a bounded ordinary-method G0 if a real comparison remains.
document_sync: passed documentation-acceptance.json; current status, handoff, total plan, execution plan and validation synchronized
preservation: Existing dirty tree, production source, historical acceptance and raw records retained; exact five document snapshots in before/
